meaning: For patients with at least one oncology diagnosis coded as Cholera durch Vibrio cholerae O:1, Biovar cholerae (ICD-10-GM A00.0, including sub-codes), gives the average, minimum and maximum age recorded with that record.
query: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) (ROUND(AVG(?age)) AS ?avg_age) (MIN(?age) AS ?min_age) (MAX(?age) AS ?max_age) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?r a sphn:OncologyDiagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?r_c . ?r_c isa icd-10-gm:A00.0 . ?r sphn:hasSubjectAge ?a . ?a sphn:hasQuantity/sphn:hasValue ?age . } }

meaning: Per year of the record date time, counts distinct patients and records with at least one oncology diagnosis coded as Bösartige Neubildungen der männlichen Genitalorgane (ICD-10-GM C60-C63, including sub-codes).
query: SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?r) AS ?records) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?r a sphn:OncologyDiagnosis ; sphn:hasCode ?r_c . ?r_c isa icd-10-gm:C60-C63 . ?r sphn:hasRecordDateTime ?date . } BIND(YEAR(?date) AS ?year) } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY ?year
